_comment: Shot list for icube-emu.com and the App Store.
Steps are declarative; capture.py drives them through RocketSim's
accessibility tree, so a control that gets renamed is a label fix here
rather than a code change. Every label/type/value below was taken from a
real `rocketsim elements --agent --agent-mode act` read, not guessed.
Two matcher notes, both learned the hard way:
* label matching is 'contains', so a title like 'Settings' hits both the
button and its wrapping group — pair it with "type": "button".
* the library search field has NO accessibility label; 'Search' is its
placeholder, carried as the value. Hence type+value for that step.
Filenames (minus .png) are the keys the website's
scripts/import-screenshots.mjs looks up in captions.json.
Every shot relaunches the app first, so shots are independent and order
does not matter. 'verify'/'reject' annotate a capture rather than
discarding it, because a human reviews every PNG before import.
Not covered, and why: gameplay and the pause menu need a booted game, and
the simulator has no JIT/Vulkan path (and demo entries have no disc image)
— capture those on a device. The per-game context menu is not reachable:
GameGridItem's .onLongPressGesture(0.5) enters multi-select and consumes
the press before .contextMenu can open. The Shaders page is currently a
debug-checkbox screen rather than a picker, so Graphics ▸ Enhancements is
the graphics-quality shot instead.
